pages.title: Chocolate, Tea and Coffee
pages.text: Two addons turn Create into a sweet shop and a cafe. **Create Confectionery** handles chocolate, candy and gingerbread. **Create Cafe** handles coffee, tea and syrups. Both lean on Create's mixing, filling and compacting.

pages.title: Confectionery
pages.text: Chocolate comes in milk, dark, white and ruby as fluids. Compact it into bars or build with chocolate bricks. Also candy, caramel, marshmallow and gingerbread.

pages.title: More sweets
pages.text: Candy cane tools, a Gingerbread Man mob and hot chocolate drinks round out Confectionery. White, dark and hot chocolate use [#](2E5AAC)[Ratatouille](entry://food/ratatouille)[#]()'s cocoa butter and powder. Look recipes up in JEI with **R**.

pages.title: Coffee
pages.text: Coffee fruit is crushed to beans, roasted in a smoker, then milled or crushed to grounds. Syrups flavour drinks, applied with a Spout.

pages.title: Tea and Syrups
pages.text: Mixed over heat from fruit, melted sugar and often milk or water. Fruit from Fruits Delight, Berries and Cherries, Twilight Forest and Northstar all count.

The mixing recipes need a Blaze Burner under the mixer. Tapioca flour, oreo and crushed cookies give bubble tea style toppings.

Blood Oranges come from haunting an orange with a Fan. Mana Berries come from filling sweet berries with 25 mB of liquid experience in a Spout.

Heat: [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#](). Serving to customers: [#](2E5AAC)[Cozy Cafe](entry://food/cozy_cafe)[#]().
